info.title: EpiCare AI
info.description:
**EpiCare AI** is a robust and comprehensive platform designed to manage and analyze epilepsy-related data, facilitating seamless interactions between patients, doctors, and caretakers.

### Core Features
- **Admin Dashboard**: Comprehensive system metrics and doctor PMDC verification tools.
- **User Management**: Unified profiles tailored for Patients, Doctors, and Caretakers.
- **Role-Based Authentication**: Secure access control with PMDC verification for doctors.
- **Connection System**: Connect patients with verified medical professionals and trusted caretakers.
- **AI-Driven EEG Analysis**: Upload EEG sessions, process signals, and receive detailed AI-generated seizure prediction reports.
- **Personalized Dashboard**: Get real-time heuristic recommendations based on daily habits.
- **Lifestyle & Medication Tracking**: Log sleep, stress, triggers, and medications with adherence algorithms.
- **Emergency SOS**: Instantly dispatch multi-channel (Firebase/WhatsApp/Email) SOS alerts to configured contacts.

This API adheres strictly to REST principles, delivering standardized responses and explicit HTTP status codes to ensure a reliable developer experience.

get.description: Detailed health check probe returning DB status, Redis status, and application version. Used by load balancers and deployment probes to check system liveness.

200.description: Successful Response - System is healthy or degraded

get.description: Report which AI model version is active and whether it is loaded into memory.

post.description: Registers a new user (Patient, Doctor, or Caretaker). A 6-digit OTP will be sent to the user's email address.

400.description: Bad Request - Validation error or email already registered

429.description: Too Many Requests - Rate limit exceeded

post.description: Authenticate with email and password to receive access and refresh tokens. Ensures account is active, email is verified, and (if Doctor) PMDC is verified.

403.description: Forbidden - Account deactivated, unverified email, or unverified PMDC

429.description: Too Many Requests - Login rate limit exceeded

post.description: Verify the 6-digit OTP sent to the user's email.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid or expired OTP

post.description: Resend a new 6-digit OTP to the provided email if the account is unverified. Defends against enumeration by returning success regardless of user existence.

400.description: Bad Request - Email is already verified

429.description: Too Many Requests - Rate limit exceeded

post.description: Generate a new set of access and refresh tokens using a valid existing refresh token.

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or expired refresh token

post.description: Acknowledge logout intention (client-side clears the tokens).

get.description: Retrieve the base User model information (email, role, verification status) for the authenticated user.

patch.description: Update base user account information (like name or phone number).

post.description: Change the authenticated user's password securely by verifying their current password.

get.description: Retrieve the current authenticated user's patient profile.

404.description: Patient profile not found for this user

put.description: Create or completely update the current user's patient profile.

delete.description: Delete the current user's patient profile. The underlying user account remains active.

get.description: Retrieve the current authenticated user's doctor profile, including PMDC verification status.

404.description: Doctor profile not found for this user

put.description: Update the current user's doctor profile details.

delete.description: Delete the current user's doctor profile. The underlying user account remains active.

get.description: Retrieve the current authenticated user's caretaker profile.

404.description: Caretaker profile not found for this user

put.description: Create or completely update the current user's caretaker profile.

delete.description: Delete the current user's caretaker profile. The underlying user account remains active.

post.description: Upload an EEG file (EDF/CSV format) to create a new analysis session. Returns the created session details. Rate limits apply.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid file format or file too large

429.description: Too Many Requests - Upload rate limit exceeded

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all EEG sessions uploaded by the current authenticated user.
Retrieve the details, validation result, and status pipeline for a single EEG session.

404.description: Not Found - Session does not exist or belongs to another user

post.description: Trigger the full AI analysis pipeline for the given session (validation, preprocessing, inference) and return the generated seizure prediction report.

400.description: Bad Request - Session already analyzed, or file invalid

404.description: Not Found - Session does not exist or belongs to another user

500.description: Internal Server Error - ML pipeline failed

get.description: Download or serve the generated spectrogram PNG image for a processed EEG session.

200.description: Successful Response - Returns an image/png file

404.description: Not Found - Session or spectrogram does not exist

get.description: Retrieve the latest seizure prediction and AI report associated with an analyzed session.

404.description: Not Found - Session or prediction does not exist

get.description: Retrieve comprehensive platform metrics including user counts, and engagement stats.
Retrieve all users with optional pagination and role filtering.

schema.title: Response List Users Api V1 Admin Users Get

get.description: Fetch a specific user's base information by their ID.

patch.description: Suspend or restore a user account.

get.description: Fetch all doctors whose PMDC numbers are awaiting verification.

schema.title: Response Get Pending Doctors Api V1 Admin Doctors Pending Get

patch.description: Approve or reject a doctor's PMDC verification request.

get.description: Fetch live DB, OS, and ML runtime diagnostics.
Search for a PMDC-verified doctor by their PMDC number. Only patients can search for doctors.

schema.title: Response Search Doctors Api V1 Connections Doctors Search Get

403.description: Forbidden - Only patients can search for doctors

post.description: Patient sends a connection request to a doctor. A patient can only have one active/pending connection with a specific doctor.

400.description: Bad Request - Connection already exists or is pending

403.description: Forbidden - Only patients can request doctor connections

404.description: Not Found - Patient profile or doctor not found

post.description: A PMDC-verified doctor approves a pending connection request from a patient.

400.description: Bad Request - Connection is not in pending status

403.description: Forbidden - Only verified doctors can approve connections

404.description: Not Found - Connection request not found

delete.description: Patient revokes an active or pending doctor connection.

403.description: Forbidden - Only patients can revoke doctor connections

404.description: Not Found - Connection request not found

post.description: Patient requests a connection using the caretaker's email.

400.description: Bad Request - Connection already exists or is pending

403.description: Forbidden - Only patients can request connections

404.description: Not Found - Patient profile or caretaker not found

get.description: Caretaker views all pending connection requests.

schema.title: Response Get Pending Caretaker Requests Api V1 Connections Caretakers Pending Get

post.description: Caretaker approves a pending connection request.

400.description: Bad Request - Connection is not in pending status

404.description: Not Found - Connection request not found

delete.description: Patient revokes an active or pending caretaker connection.

403.description: Forbidden - Only patients can revoke caretaker connections

404.description: Not Found - Connection request not found

get.description: Retrieves the list of configured emergency contacts for the authenticated patient.

200.description: A list of emergency contact objects.

schema.title: Response Get Emergency Contacts Api V1 Emergency Contacts Get

post.description: Adds a new emergency contact for the authenticated patient. A maximum of 3 emergency contacts are permitted per patient.

201.description: The newly created emergency contact object.

put.description: Updates an existing emergency contact's details (e.g., phone number or name).

delete.description: Removes an emergency contact from the patient's list.

post.description: Triggers an immediate Emergency SOS alert. This logs the event along with the patient's current GPS coordinates (if available) and instantly dispatches asynchronous background tasks to notify all registered emergency contacts via the configured provider (e.g., WhatsApp, Email).

200.description: An object acknowledging the trigger with the SOS event ID.

get.description: Fetches a list of all medication prescriptions registered to the authenticated patient.

schema.title: Response Get Medications Api V1 Medications Get

post.description: Registers a new medication prescription for the patient. Includes details like dosage, frequency, and start date. Used for tracking adherence.

put.description: Updates details for an existing medication (e.g. changing the dosage or making it inactive).

delete.description: Soft deletes a medication by marking it as inactive. This preserves historical adherence logs.

get.description: Retrieves all scheduled intake times for a specific medication.

schema.title: Response Get Schedules Api V1 Medications  Med Id  Schedules Get

post.description: Adds a specific intake schedule (time and days) for a medication. If reminders are enabled, background jobs will automatically notify the patient when it is time to take this dose.
Manually logs a medication dose as TAKEN, MISSED, or SKIPPED. These logs are analyzed by the Recommender service to calculate adherence scores.

get.description: Retrieves a descending history of all sleep logs recorded by the patient.

200.description: A list of sleep log entries.

schema.title: Response Get Sleep Logs Api V1 Lifestyle Sleep Get

post.description: Logs a sleep session for the authenticated patient. The system automatically calculates the total duration in minutes. Used to monitor sleep deprivation.

201.description: The newly created sleep log object.

get.description: Fetches a descending list of all documented triggers for the patient.

schema.title: Response Get Trigger Logs Api V1 Lifestyle Triggers Get

post.description: Logs an environmental or behavioral trigger (e.g., Flashing Lights, High Stress). These triggers are aggregated by the Recommender service to warn the patient of patterns.
A specialized endpoint to record the patient's daily stress severity on a 1-5 scale. This maps generically to a LifestyleLog in the database.

201.description: The generated lifestyle log representing stress.

post.description: Log menstruation flow to help correlate with catamenial epilepsy patterns.

201.description: The generated lifestyle log representing menstruation.

post.description: Track ketogenic diet compliance and alcohol intake (a common seizure trigger).

201.description: The generated lifestyle log representing diet/alcohol.

post.description: Track illnesses and fevers, which can drastically lower the seizure threshold.

201.description: The generated lifestyle log representing illness.

post.description: Log adverse side effects of anti-epileptic drugs (AEDs) like fatigue or dizziness.

201.description: The generated lifestyle log representing a medication side effect.

post.description: Track screen time and device usage, as excessive screen time can trigger seizures in some patients.

201.description: The generated lifestyle log representing screen time.

get.description: Retrieves the aggregated health analytics for the authenticated patient over the **past 30 days**. This includes total seizures detected, average daily sleep hours, and medication adherence percentages. It also calculates and returns real-time, personalized recommendations based on the patient's recent lifestyle logs.

200.description: A JSON object containing the dashboard statistics and recommendations.

get.description: Retrieve a descending history of all manually logged seizures for the authenticated patient.

200.description: A list of manual seizure logs.

schema.title: Response Get Manual Seizures Api V1 Seizures Manual Get

post.description: Manually log a seizure that occurred while the patient was not wearing an EEG device. Tracks core clinical metrics like duration, auras, and post-ictal symptoms.

201.description: The newly created manual seizure log.

put.description: Updates a manual seizure log to correct accidental mistakes.

delete.description: Deletes a manual seizure log completely.
